state.incidentInput: Customers are seeing errors at checkout and the site feels slow. Started maybe 15-20 min ago.
state.summary: Likely cause remains CFG-502: inventory-service DB_POOL_MAX 20->80 over-committed orders-db (inventory holds ~318 of 397 connections, LOG-076). That starved orders-service of connections (LOG-040) and has failed checkout since 13:55. Payments v2.14.0 is not supported as the cause. It was rolled back at 14:18 (DEP-103), checkout 5xx kept firing (ALR-014), and the payments error rate never moved. Confidence is 0.85 and the cause is not human-confirmed.
state.impact: From 13:55 checkout errors (peak 7.9%) and p99 up to 5s; orders errors up to 10%. 87 tickets by 14:30 (CUST-001); 14 report card charged but no order confirmation (CUST-002). Not region-specific (CUST-005).
